about_the_game:
Death is inevitable. 

Dash your way through the different hellishly difficult areas, while assisting Death with getting his subjects under control.

You're going to die. A lot.

Working as a subject of Death, it's inevitable. Learn and master the mechanics of the ghoulish dash to overcome the difficulty and die less.

Experience Hell

Death will need your help in all areas of Hell, so you'll see everything from the Tree Tops to the Barracks, and with true skill, maybe even Ascension.

Complete Death's List

Death works in his mysterious ways, and for some reason he needs you to fulfil very specific requirements for each level, awarding you with game-altering sigils.

Alter the Rules

Death's Sigils will change the game's fundamental rules, creating a completely new challenge to dive into.

content_descriptors.notes: Cartoonish depictions of suicide, death, and skeletons on crosses.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 4600H
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1660 TI
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Will probably run on slower systems

short_description: In this difficult 3D platformer where precision is key and a single wrong movement could be your death. Master the movements to get the fastest times and fulfill Death's List.
